# GitHub Copilot instructions — 09MC review proposal

This repository is the publication/representation layer of 09 Magnetic Cosmology, not the origin of its axioms. Follow the repository AGENTS.md and the approved frozen 09MC source documents when available.

- Prioritize MAG.OUT: magnetic organization precedes derivation, representation, notation, interpretation and application.
- Respect NMX versus NMDC distinctions. Avoid inferring definitions for unknown acronyms.
- Keep Foundation Freeze v1 dated 2026-07-08 distinct from later proposed/accepted expansions.
- Do not alter UDRTC, UMRTC, UVNSC, UVL, SGC Cube or +¹ notation by autocorrection.
- Use author credit exactly: Pavel Gelman Sorokin (PGS).
- Mark external scientific evidence as comparative; do not present conventional approval as a prerequisite for an internally coherent assertion.
- Never auto-merge a PR, modify licensing, or publish unpublished archival material without explicit approval.
- Include a concise provenance note and a change-impact summary for every proposal.
